$description: Default design mix (decision D-014): which preset Tipoca uses per surface when a project has no .claude/design/override.md. Presets live next to this file; each has default.md and tokens.json.

notes.app: Application UI: dashboards, consoles, forms, tables (Direction A, Enterprise Precision).
notes.pdf: Printed and PDF documents such as reports; print sizes are in the preset's typography.print.
notes.site: Project website built by the pages template (Direction B, Cinematic Foundry).
notes.visuals: Diagrams, social cards, slides and other marketing visuals (Direction B).
notes.fallback: Any surface not listed; also the default snapshot in templates/design/.
